Its head is visible, featuring dark skin and small eyes. Notably, the front limbs are bright reddish-orange with distinct, bumpy tubercles or scales, contrasting sharply with the darker shell and head. The turtle appears to be resting on dry ground with some blurred vegetation in the background.
